title: Longitudinal Cognitive Assessment by BoCA
summary: The Boston Cognitive Assessment (BoCA) is a self-administered online test intended for longitudinal cognitive monitoring. BoCA uses random not-repeating tasks to minimize learning effects. BoCA was developed to evaluate the effects of treatment in longitudinal clinical trials and available gratis to individuals and professionals.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

age 50 or older

Exclusion Criteria:

younger than 50 years
